layout.hierarchy: The peach diagram panel dominates the slide. Title is the largest/boldest text (black with red spans). Red is the attention-grabbing color: all math-entity labels (K, V, Y, q, Z), the 3 red 3D block arrows, the thin red connector lines and the K.q/√d fraction, and the Z₂ dashed highlight are red — exceptions: the Σ→O arrow is green #00B050, the decoder-caption arrow is white, and the 12 row-to-box arrows are thin black. Yellow containers/pills (2 Y-containers, 3 callout pills, slide-number badge) act as secondary anchors; small black bold text inside colored boxes is tertiary; vertical column captions are mid-weight.

visual_elements.description: Encoder-decoder cross-attention dataflow, left to right. (1) LEFT INPUT: red 3D block arrow at slide edge (pointing outward-left); hatched rectangle 'From Encoder Output' (red bold text, white center, red diagonal-hatch side panels); below it a yellow rounded container with dashed green border holding 4 rows (top→bottom Y₄, Y₃, Y₂, Y₁), each row a yellow strip of 4 small white cells with the red Y-label in the first cell; black right-arrows from each row into green boxes 'W_k^(r)'; black right-arrows into small vertically-striped (white/pale-yellow) boxes labeled K₄, K₃, K₂, K₁ in red. (2) DOT PRODUCT: thin lines from all 4 K boxes converge into a tall gray-tan box titled 'Dot Product' containing 4 blue dots joined by an all-to-all mesh of thin red lines (6 pairwise lines); a thin line also enters from below from q₂; yellow pill 'Similarity' floats above-left; red 'K.q' label at top-right exit. (3) SCALING: red fraction K.q over √d above a tall pink column with bottom-to-top vertical text 'Scaling by √d'. (4) SOFTMAX: adjacent tall violet column with vertical text 'Soft max'; yellow pill 'Probabilities' above. (5) WEIGHTED SUM: four small circles with red '×' stacked vertically receive lines from Soft max on the left and lines labeled V₄, V₃, V₂, V₁ from the right; those V lines originate at blue boxes 'W_v^(r)' which receive black left-arrows from a mirrored yellow Y-container (Y₄…Y₁) fed by a second hatched 'From Encoder Output' box with a red 3D block arrow pointing outward-right at the slide edge; each × output rises into a light-blue rectangle with a large black 'Σ'; yellow pill 'Weighted SUM' above; thick green arrow points up from Σ to a green box 'O' flanked by small striped vector cells. (6) DECODER QUERY (bottom): pink rounded container with four striped cells Z₁, Z₂, Z₃, Z₄ (Z₂ highlighted with red dashed border); thick red 3D arrow points up at Z₂ from below the container; above the container sit a white box 'W_q^(r)' topped by red 'q₂' with a small striped vector glyph, with a thin line from q₂ up into the Dot Product dots; magenta caption 'From Decoder Self Attention Layer' with a white 3D arrow pointing left toward the Z-row.
